dialect.detail: CCVS-74/COBOL-85 Version 4.2 (Apr 1993) compliance validation suite from the Federal Compiler Testing Centre / GSA / NIST. Tests obsolete COBOL-74 level-1 language elements as defined in the 1985 standard.

purpose.domain_detail: NIST/GSA CCVS COBOL compiler validation suite testing obsolete COBOL-74 level-1 language elements under COBOL-85 standard
purpose.summary: This program is part of the NIST CCVS (COBOL Compiler Validation System) test suite. It tests COBOL-74 level-1 language elements that were declared obsolete in the 1985 standard, including REMARKS paragraph, MEMORY SIZE clause, ALTER statement, and various display/accept features. It produces a printed report of pass/fail results.

notable_features: Tests obsolete COBOL-74 constructs (REMARKS paragraph, MEMORY SIZE, ALTER)
X-card placeholder substitution (XXXXX055, XXXXX082, XXXXX083, XXXXX067)
High PERFORM count (88) and GOTO count (46) typical of CCVS test structure
Fixed format with sequence numbers in columns 73-80
verdict.notes: Source is truncated to first 16000 chars of a 63342-byte file (782 lines total). The program-id in the source is OBNC1M but the sequence field shows OBNC14.2, consistent with NIST CCVS naming conventions. No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS. The embedded 'phony' division text in the AUTHOR comment area is intentional — it tests that comment entries are not compiled.
